messages.subject: qplot and ggsave
parts:
Hello everybody,
A while ago I installed rapache on my server and was testing around
with it, now I am working on a fisheries related project where I am
trying to build a web application.
Strangely I managed to run correlations and produce related graphs
with qplot, save them as png with ggsave and display them on the page.
Although now I tried to do the same thing with Market prices of the
species on another page, the script appears to be running fine, I get
my subset of the table showing up exactly as it should, but as soon as
I add :

b<-qplot(Dates,Price, geom=c("point","line"),ylab="
Price in Euros",
main=paste("Ijmuiden Veiling:",spec))
ggsave(file="/opt/local/apache2/htdocs/oriong/
vei.png",height=6,width=9,b) %>

I keep receiving the following error in my apache log:

Error in if (length(range) == 1 || diff(range) == 0) { :
 missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In readLines(icon, 1) :
 incomplete final line found on '/opt/local/apache2/htdocs/brew/
graph.rhtml'
2: In readLines(icon, 1) :
 incomplete final line found on '/opt/local/apache2/htdocs/brew/
graph.rhtml'
3: In readLines(icon, 1) :
 incomplete final line found on '/opt/local/apache2/htdocs/brew/
graph.rhtml'
4: In readLines(icon, 1) :
 incomplete final line found on '/opt/local/apache2/htdocs/brew/
graph.rhtml'
Function brew returned an object of 'try-error'.

I do not really understand this error as when I run the script offline
everything seem to work fine and my graph is saved properly.

Does anyone have any idea what this error really means?

Thanks!
Sven
